name: SoldComps
description: eBay sold-comps API for resellers and analysts — one keyword returns up to 200 completed sales with real prices, conditions, and dates.

mentions.evidence: ~$18.8k MRR, 488 active subscriptions, ~$18.8k L30, ~$38.1k all-time, founded Mar 2025, Canada. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Wrap a marketplace's awkward public data into a paid API — same shape as ControlResell ops, but for pricing intel.

whyItPrints: Resellers live on sold comps. eBay's own APIs are restricted/messy; SoldComps sells clean access at $9–$79/mo. Pure data plumbing for a sweaty niche.
whyThisMatters:
Resellers and flippers need the price something actually sold for. SoldComps is an API of completed eBay sales. One request with your API key returns up to 240 sold listings as JSON. You skip OAuth. You skip XML. Each row includes the sold price, the date, the condition, shipping, the seller's feedback, and a link back to the listing. Asking prices and estimates aren't in the response.

You can filter by category, price, condition, and a date window. Eight eBay marketplaces are covered: the US, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Canada, and Australia. History on a search goes back up to 90 days. A request counts once, whether it returns 10 items or the full 240. The free tier doesn't ask for a card. Larger packs add more requests per month, and you can move up, move down, or cancel from the dashboard.

Developers drop it into a pricing tool or a spreadsheet workflow. A person pricing a phone, a card, or a used gadget can do the same from a keyword. The company is in Canada and started in March 2025. You send a search. You get real transactions back.
